project_info.name: DealCFO
project_info.theme: Dark Slate (Zinc/Slate #09090B or #0F172A base) with Emerald accent (#10B981) and Light Mode toggle support
project_info.description: Institutional-grade M&A Deal & Financial Intelligence Platform with Deal Pipeline Tracker, EV/EBITDA & DCF Valuation Estimator, Cash Runway Analytics, EBITDA Adjustments, and Interactive Deal Intake.

colors.contrast_rules: Always ensure text contrast passes WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum). In dark mode, avoid pure black (#000000); use deep zinc/slate (#09090b or #0c0e12). Set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:text-emerald-400 or hover:text-white). NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlay cards.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: High Density Grid (MODE B) for analytics and dashboard widgets. Responsive layout using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column grid system.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous internal padding (p-4, p-6, p-8) on cards to prevent text overflow or border touch.
layout_and_spacing.card_borders: 1px solid border with subtle inner highlight. Rounded radius rounded-xl or rounded-lg.
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: Sticky or fixed top header with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-zinc-950/80 or bg-white/80), z-50, displaying logo, active workspace/deal room selector, theme toggle, search bar, and intake button.

deal_pipeline_tracker.description: Visual Kanban/Stage flow board featuring key M&A stages: Lead Sourcing, Initial Review, NDA Signed, Confid. Teaser / CIM, IOI Submitted, LOI / Exclusivity, Due Diligence, Definitive Docs, Closed Won, Passed/Archived. Includes stage metric pills, deal valuation tags, progress sliders, and quick stage action triggers.

valuation_dcf_estimator.description: Interactive valuation multiples (EV/EBITDA, EV/Revenue, P/E) & DCF scenario modeling calculator. Sliders & input fields for Revenue Growth %, EBITDA Margin %, WACC (Discount Rate), Terminal Growth Rate %, and Exit Multiple. Calculates Implied Enterprise Value, Equity Value, and Sensitivity Matrix table.

cash_runway_burn_analytics.description: Cash Runway and Monthly Burn rate interactive charts (Recharts AreaChart / BarChart). Shows cash balance projection, net burn, gross burn, runway months alert badges, and scenario stress-testing (e.g., +15% hiring burn vs revenue acceleration).

deals_table_and_modal.description: Interactive deals datatable with multi-column sorting, filtering by sector/stage/size, search, pagination, status indicators, and 'New Deal Intake' modal dialog with full financial metrics form.

ebitda_adjustments_schedule.description: Quality of Earnings (QoE) style EBITDA bridge & adjustments schedule. Add/remove owner excess comp, one-time legal fees, non-recurring IT migrations, adjusted EBITDA calculation, and visual waterfall/bar representation.

financial_kpi_cards.description: 4 key metric cards displaying Active Pipeline Value ($M), Avg EV/EBITDA Multiple, Portfolio Weighted Cash Runway (Months), and YTD Closed Deal Volume with sparkline trends and YoY growth indicators.

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Card hover state: border-emerald-500/30 or border-zinc-700, shadow-lg, subtle hover lift -translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties like transition-color, transition-transform, or transition-opacity. NEVER transition: all.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and include smooth tab transitions.

visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped badge with subtle colored backgrounds (e.g., bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on sticky navbar and filter bars with backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70 border-b border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders (border-zinc-800 or border-slate-200 in light mode).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient subtle elevation shadow-sm to shadow-xl.

image_urls.description: Close-up photo of modern financial monitor displaying dark theme trading & financial charts
Financial analytics papers with charts on desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the Vite + React build completes with zero errors (npm run build or yarn build).
Ensure dark mode is default with zinc-950/900 surfaces and vibrant emerald (#10b981) primary buttons & metrics, with a working Light Mode toggle.

Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select triggers, table rows, tabs, modal triggers, sliders) using kebab-case role naming (e.g. data-testid='deal-intake-submit-button', data-testid='dcf-wacc-slider').
Use Lucide React icons for clean, dense institutional UI representation.
DO NOT use generic centered hero text or plain text placeholders. Fill the dashboard with rich realistic M&A mock data (e.g., SaaS, HealthTech, Industrial IoT deals, $5M - $120M EV).
Support stateful interactions: users can add deals, filter by pipeline stage, tweak DCF parameters live with instant chart updates, add EBITDA adjustment line items, and switch views seamlessly.
